headline: SAFF holds steady at 4.32 on Female Daily with the most reviews tracked; packaging (new bottle size, Eulalie's weak bottle score) is now the most repeated SAFF pain point.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: SAFF's Female Daily rating is flat at 4.32 on 1,746 reviews (no change since 30 Oct). It is now second to Alchemist only by 0.11 after Alchemist slipped to 4.43.
S.O.T.B still holds a third of SAFF's reviews at 4.1; recent reviews praise 6–8 hour wear, but one calls it heady and 'too common now'.
Packaging comes up in 4 of the 9 new SAFF mentions, 3 of them critical: the new bottle is hard to carry (Loui), Eulalie's bottle scores 5.9/10 on Parfumo, and some boxes arrive dented.
Longevity is mixed by scent: Minouet and S.O.T.B are praised for wear, while Cascavel has the lowest recommend rate seen (86%) with weak-longevity comments.
Official-store reviews are much higher than Female Daily: Cloud Mist Sonnet rates 4.8 from 1,165 Tokopedia ratings, with 94% satisfied.

recommendations.text: Dig into S.O.T.B and Loui low-star reviews (marketplace export) to see if 'too strong / headache' is a pattern, then add wear guidance (spray count, day vs night) to product pages.
Add a travel or slim bottle and review Eulalie's bottle design; ask QC to check leaks and outer-box damage in shipping.
Review Cascavel's longevity after the 2023 reformulation; consider a sample-first offer or clearer longevity claims.
Flag suspicious, machine-written reviews to Female Daily and keep review requests organic to protect rating trust.
Run a short quarterly survey (awareness, consideration, NPS) so the report covers all brand health KPIs, not only online sentiment.
